# CDAL Quality Gates for Antigravity & Gemini Agents

This project operates under the Contract-Driven Agentic Loop (CDAL).

## 1. Core Principles
- **Contracts as Single Source of Truth**: All invariants live in `contracts/*.contract.mjs`.
- **Role Scopes**: Respect designated write scopes. Implementers must NEVER modify tests.
- **Traceability**: All test cases must specify their requirement: `// @REQ: <ID>`.

## 2. Verification Pipeline
- `node packages/cli/bin/cdal.mjs validate --strict`
- `node packages/cli/bin/cdal.mjs codegen --check`
- `pnpm typecheck`
- `pnpm lint`
- `pnpm test`
- `node packages/cli/bin/cdal.mjs trace --enforce`
- `node packages/cli/bin/cdal.mjs selftest`

## 3. Forbidden Patterns
- `ts-ignore`: Silencing type errors (@ts-ignore / @ts-expect-error) is prohibited. Fix types properly.
- `as-any`: Unsafe casting to "any" (as any) is prohibited. Model types explicitly.
- `skipped-test`: Muted or isolated tests (.skip / .only) are prohibited. Test suite must run fully.
- `gate-evasion-split-identifier`: Split identifier detected (join with empty separator or literal concatenation). Do not obscure identifiers to evade scanning.
- `gate-evasion-prisma-recast`: Double-casting Prisma client via unknown (prisma as unknown as X) is prohibited. It circumvents type verification.

## 4. Phase Gates
Always run `npx cdalkit phase <contract|red|green>` to verify git diff compliance.
